note: Hand descriptors (harvest/l9/hand9.py): the ONLY hand-authored input of the generic gripper layer. tips = fingertip (distal) links; opposition = list of [tips on side A, tips on side B] pairs (thumb vs the rest, or a finger pair). The finger chains (tip + its ancestors below the base link), the closing path, the free-gap table, the fingertip contact points and the grasp frame are derived by tools/onboard/hand_sweep.py from the gripper URDF (same file name .urdf) collision meshes. path = 'table' (the gripper json width_to_joint rows, densified) or 'limits' (new robots: every finger joint from its open limit to its closed limit, the closing side found by FK).
